entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: It seems you still don't understand[n]what happens when you defy me.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: ...I will destroy you with my own[n]two hands.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What is this power!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Careful! Those muscles aren't just for[n]show!

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: You will regret your actions.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: ...You've angered me for the last time.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Not bad...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: But there is no reason for me to lose[n]to thieves!

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: How are these lowlife brats beating me?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Now's our chance! Let's take his Treasure!

entries.speaker: (SE)シャドウ獅童
entries.en: Don't think you've won.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: The power held by the most elite is[n]what rules over our society...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: It's vexing that I have to use this on[n]some foolish brats...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: But I will educate you through and[n]through!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He's still gonna come at us!?
Time to do this!
Let's take his heart.
What a hassle...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You hear that, Shido!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, our next move is gonna[n]end this once and for all!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No way! He's even stronger now!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: ...Die.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Isn't this supposed to be... a "game"[n]arranged by God?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Why are the signs of defeat pointing[n]in my direction!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're a disgrace!

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: I accept that you are my destined[n]enemy.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: ...Let us have a duel to end this.[n]Just you and me.
Bring it on.
I accept.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Well put.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: I... shall win this game!

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: The ideals of the masses...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: My... ambitions...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: The sea is... swallowing them all...
